artworks.title: Venus Lamenting over Adonis' Death
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching depicting a landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The composition includes detailed clouds, distant mountains, intricate trees and foliage, human figures, and a winged figure in motion. The middle ground features cross-hatched trees, while hills lead towards distant mountains. The artwork emphasizes light and dark contrast through shading.

artworks.title: Georg Roggenbach
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, holding a rolled object with one hand resting on a surface. He has a beard and mustache, deep-set eyes, and wears a flat cap. He is wearing a richly detailed outfit, including a fur-trimmed overcoat and an embroidered undergarment. In the background, there is an emblem on the wall behind him and a landscape view with a castle visible through a window on the right. The portrait appears to be an engraving or etching, with inscriptions at the base.

artworks.title: Gorge in the Rocks (Gorge dans les rochers)
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky landscape with large boulders on both sides. The horizon is positioned low in the image, just above the middle, and there are birds flying in the sky. The illustration uses detailed etching or line drawing with strong lines and crosshatching for texture and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of black and sepia tones.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Bridge and Ruined Tower
artworks.description: The etching depicts a landscape with figures walking on a path. A man on a mule, accompanied by another person on foot and a dog, is moving to the right. A stone bridge leads to rocky terrain. Distant mountains and clouds mark the horizon. The fine lines detail trees, rock textures, and water. The black and white etching uses shading and line density to create depth. In the background, a statue stands on a hill, and trees and structures are visible.

artworks.title: The Singer at the Country Fair
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a performer engaging an audience. The central figure is using a stick to point at a large board displaying illustrations. The scene is crowded, with the audience surrounding the performer. The background contains detailed foliage from large trees. Numerous onlookers are depicted, appearing captivated by the performance.

artworks.title: Bust of an Old Man in Profile, Facing Right
artworks.description: This image is a portrait of a person in profile facing to the right. The individual has a long beard and curly hair, with a sharp nose and deep-set eyes. They wear a cloak or robe over their shoulders. In the background, there is an inscription at the top left corner, the surface is plain and textured.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child with Saints Gimignano, John the Baptist, George and Peter Martyr
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch featuring multiple figures. To the left, a man is seated in a crouching position, with his head tilted back and looking upwards. He has long hair and is wearing draped, flowing clothing. Next to him, another figure with similar features is standing, draped in a toga-like garment, looking outward with an intense gaze. To the right, another man stands partially with hints of clothing. In the upper left corner, a man wearing a large mitre observes the scene. Above all figures, the faint outline of more figures can be seen in the background, possibly resembling cloud-like formations or celestial beings. The background remains mostly empty, emphasizing the figures in the foreground.

artworks.title: Allegorical Figure
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central nude figure standing on a winged globe. There is a mythical creature nearby, resembling a sea serpent or dragon. In the background, a cityscape is visible on the right side, with clouds and two faces in the distance. The drawing is done in red and black chalk with sketch-like qualities, showing visible lines and shading for depth and volume.

artworks.title: Woman Carrying a Tray
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a robed figure. The image depicts a classical figure with dynamic flowing drapery. The figure is reaching forward, while the drapery curves around the body. Bold lines define the figure and drapery on a textured background. The shading and line work suggest an illustrative style, contributing to the energy and motion within the composition.

artworks.title: Woman Carrying a Tray
artworks.description: The image features bold, curving lines outlining a dynamic figure in motion, with flowing shapes suggesting the movement of fabric or wind. The abstract composition resembles a figure draped in a cloak or garment, with the lines evoking swirling motion. The arrangement of lines and contours creates the impression of musculature and fabric folds, drawing connections to dance or wind-swept attire.

artworks.title: Figures Studies [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. John Steiner
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures depicted from roughly the knee upwards, with varying completeness. The figures are positioned closely together in a crowded manner, some facing forward while others are turned in profile. The facial features are detailed with defined noses, eyes, and lips. Many figures have elaborate hairstyles or head coverings, and the clothing is detailed with fine lines, including drapery and folds suggesting movement. One figure has an outstretched arm. Some figures seem to be interacting through body positioning and gestures. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects. The background is neutral, focusing on the density and interaction of the figures.

artworks.title: Birds in Flight [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. John Steiner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several birds in flight. It depicts a collection of small, ink sketches of birds in various poses mid-flight. The birds vary in orientation, with some showing frontal views while others present their profiles. The lines are delicate, capturing the essence of movement. The overall composition has ample negative space surrounding the sketches. The variety in wing shapes and positions suggests a study of avian motion.

artworks.title: Joseph Revealing Himself to His Brothers in Egypt
artworks.medium: black chalk and pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. John Steiner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene with a central figure and a group of figures in an act of supplication. The drawing depicts a figure in a flowing robe, likely a person of significance, appearing to bless or address a group of kneeling individuals. The central figure is positioned to the left, extending one hand outward. The individuals surrounding this central figure are on bended knees, some with outstretched arms. The background is filled with architectural elements like columns and arches. The overall composition is intricate, with attention to the expressions and postures of the characters, emphasizing their emotional states and interactions.

artworks.title: The Marriage of Saint Catherine
artworks.medium: red and black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of her parents, Sophie and Carl Boschwitz
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two figures and a baby. The focus is on the upper half of a woman holding the baby on her lap. The woman looks down at the child. She has softly drawn facial features and wears a headscarf. The baby is unclothed and held securely. Another figure is present, partially covered by a robe and also wearing a headscarf, looking towards the woman and child. Only facial outlines and one hand are visible. The background has a faint texture, with a basket-like object at the bottom. The drawing uses soft tones and shading, giving it an ethereal quality.

artworks.title: The Holy Family Under a Canopy
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, an adult and a child, seated closely together. The adult is in a seated pose with the child on their lap. The adult has an oval face, gentle eyes, straight nose, wavy hair, and wears flowing robes. The child has soft curls and a round face, and is interacting with the adult. Both figures are surrounded by drapery and textile patterns, with a textured surface in the background suggesting a cloth canopy or curtain with tassels on the left.

artworks.title: Interior of a Farmhouse
artworks.description: The image shows a person leaning near a wooden structure that resembles a well, surrounded by kitchen utensils, pots, and vegetables. The color palette is monochromatic with a sepia-toned appearance. The person is interacting with the objects, and a rooster is visible in the center. Fabrics hang from the ceiling on the left, and other household items like baskets and tools are scattered around.

artworks.title: Figure Studies [recto]
artworks.description: The image shows sketches of women in various postures and views. The women are depicted wearing long coats, with styled hair and some wearing hats. The sketches include full-body figures in profile, as well as partial views focusing on hairstyles and coat details. The women's clothing features high collars, buttons, and folds, depicted with hatched lines. The background of the image is plain, emphasizing the figures and their fashion.

artworks.title: Figure Studies [verso]
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in different poses, drawn on a beige background. One figure in the center-right is standing, facing right, wearing a high-collared shirt. Another figure on the left is depicted with head and shoulders wearing a hat. A profile of a figure in a jacket is on the center-left. Below that, a figure with a mustache and beard is reaching forward. Additional sketches show heads with various facial features, including baldness and bushy eyebrows. The figures have formal clothing typical of the early 20th century. The drawing style is loose but detailed, capturing expressions and attire.

artworks.title: Meadow with a Shepherd and Cows
artworks.medium: black and red chalk, and pen and brush with brown ink
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a low horizon line showing small trees in the distance blending into the sky. In the foreground, there are two cows and a figure resting under a large tree. The artwork features intricate brushstrokes and pencil work, with detailed rendering of the tree's branches and foliage. The color palette is primarily brown and beige, creating a naturalistic effect. On the left side, rustic fences and a gate are visible in the fields. Birds are flying in the sky.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: etching and woodcut printed in two shades of brown ink
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 25.5 × 24.2 cm (10 1/16 × 9 1/2 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: This drawing shows a winged cherub standing on a pedestal, holding a shield. The pedestal has an inscription and is draped with fabric resembling a banner. In the background, there is a bare tree branch with a few leaves. The artwork uses line and shading to create a detailed and refined look.

artworks.title: The Winter King on the Ice
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel after Hendrick Avercamp
artworks.medium: etching and chalk manner with roulette inked à la poupée and hand-colored with wash
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 21.6 × 22.2 cm (8 1/2 × 8 3/4 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: It is a drawing of a group of figures in a town square. The foreground shows figures in period attire, including capes, hats, and masks. The central figure on the right wears a yellow outfit and holds a fan, next to a figure with a sheathed sword. The background features a crowd engaging in various activities, with architectural structures in the distance.

artworks.title: Fisherman with Pack over His Shoulder
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Ludolf Backhuysen
artworks.medium: chalk manner and aquatint with etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image depicts a seascape with a view that captures both the sea and sky. Closest to us, a figure stands on a rocky outcrop, gazing towards the water. Beyond him, a sailboat is depicted on the water, its sail billowing with the wind, as a small flag flutters at the stern. The horizon is positioned roughly in the lower third of the image, providing a clear separation between the water and the sky. The skyline includes distant land formations and other vessels that are barely discernible against the water. The sky occupies a large portion of the image, filled with clouds and streaming light that emerge from a patch of brightness near the horizon. The style is characterized by soft, diffused brushstrokes that create a sense of atmosphere and texture, particularly in the treatment of the clouds and water. The color palette is muted, using a monochrome range of earthy browns and greys.

artworks.title: Seascape with Full Moon
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel (editor) and Cornelis Brouwer (printmaker), after Ludolf Backhuysen
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The viewpoint is slightly above the water level, showing the ocean with a fleet of sailing boats in the distance. The horizon line is low in the image, emphasizing the sky and water. The brushstrokes are smooth and soft, creating a serene atmosphere. The color palette is monochromatic, ranging from light gray to dark gray. In the foreground, a small rowboat with figures is on the left, and a larger sailboat is to the right. Other sailboats are scattered across the water, with their sails catching the light. The background shows a faint outline of land and distant ships on the horizon, partially obscured by clouds and dim light.

artworks.title: War Vessel in the Y
artworks.artist: Cornelis Ploos van Amstel and Bernhard Schreuder, after Ludolf Backhuysen
artworks.medium: mezzotint and roulette with burnishing printed in black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 9.5 × 19 cm (3 3/4 × 7 1/2 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Sherwood B. Smith, Jr.
artworks.description: The image displays a maritime scene from an elevated viewpoint. The sea is visible along with ships, a horizon line with distant masts and building silhouettes near the top, and a large sailing ship in the center. A smaller vessel with a single sail is on the left, and a rowing boat with two figures is in the foreground. The artwork uses a sepia tone and fluid brushstrokes to depict the sea's motion and wind filling the sails.
